sources.name: Powerplantmatching / GEM / WRI GPD / GEO candidate records
applies_to: 27 public map plant records; estimated mapped_bus_id is not verified connectivity
sources.terms: The current PPM repository states software MIT and default output CC BY 4.0; these do not by themselves establish the rights for this custom Mongolia extract. WRI v1.3.0 and GEM publish CC BY 4.0 terms; GEO's AboutUs states CC BY 3.0 US. Local 27 rows have GEM/GPD/GEO source references in 19/7/7 rows respectively (overlapping). Exact source releases, SQLite extract rights, record lineage, notices and upstream exceptions still need review; duplicates and multiple units are retained.
